components.css: .ds-rule-band { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px 40px; padding: 20px 40px; background: var(--color-plate, #05070c); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #1b2230); font-family: var(--font-label, sans-serif); } .ds-rule-band__name { color: var(--color-bone, #e8eef7); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rule-band__nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-category-link { color: var(--color-star, #9fb6d9); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: color 120ms steps(2, end); } .ds-category-link:hover, .ds-category-link:focus-visible { color: var(--color-iris, #5683da); } .ds-category-link__count { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-star, #9fb6d9) 70%, var(--color-plate, #05070c)); }

components.css: .ds-stack { position: relative; } .ds-stack__edge { position: absolute; bottom: -6px; left: 24px; right: 24px; height: 100%; background: var(--color-plate-edge, #0a0d15); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #1b2230); border-top: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-stack__edge--near { bottom: -3px; left: 12px; right: 12px; } .ds-stack__list { position: relative; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background: var(--color-plate, #05070c); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #1b2230); }

components.css: .ds-plate-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #1b2230); } .ds-plate-row:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-plate-row__link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 144px 1fr; gap: 0 32px; align-items: baseline; padding: 20px 12px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-plate-row__date { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-star, #9fb6d9); font-family: var(--font-label, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plate-row__title { color: var(--color-bone, #e8eef7); font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-plate-row:hover .ds-plate-row__title { color: var(--color-iris, #5683da); animation: ds-plate-step 120ms steps(2, end) forwards; } .ds-plate-row__link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-iris, #5683da); outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-plate-step { 0% { transform: translateY(0); } 60% { transform: translateY(-3px); } 100% { transform: translateY(-2px); } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-plate-row__link { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px 0; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is an observatory plate atlas: a working catalogue of dated observations, printed on a near-black plate, ruled like a table and measured like an instrument. Structure is carried by hairlines and by stacked paper edges rather than by fills, cards or shadows.

Two voices carry the type: a reading serif for sentences, and a condensed grotesque in caps with tabular figures for every label, date and count. Colour is monochrome plus one lived accent, and the only warm colour in the system marks recency.
keyCharacteristics: A near-black plate with no surface fills, no cards, and no shadows.
Two voices only: a reading serif and a condensed grotesque for labels, dates and counts.
One accent per view: ember marks recency, iris belongs to interaction.
Numbers are set in tabular figures so a column of dates reads as a column.
Motion is a single mechanical step, never a glide.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Prose is bone, metadata is star, and nothing else receives colour.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember appears once per view and only as a mark of recency.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif for sentences, condensed caps for identifiers.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared with another number is set in tabular figures.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose never exceeds 65ch, at any viewport; lists are exempt because their job is alignment.

rules.name: The Rule-Band Rule
rules.body: Navigation is always a band bounded by hairlines, never a floating or shadowed header.

rules.name: The Flat-Plate Rule
rules.body: No element casts a shadow; if something must lift, it steps or it changes ink.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rounded, at any size, for any state.

rules.name: The Ruled Row Rule
rules.body: Lists are ruled rows, never cards and never nested containers.

rules.name: The One-Step Rule
rules.body: Motion is one mechanical step of 120ms with steps(2, end) and a 3px overshoot that settles at 2px.

dos: Do carry structure with 1px hairlines and 20px row rhythm instead of fills, cards or shadows.
Do set dates, counts and legends in Archivo Narrow caps with tabular figures (0.09em tracking).
Do hold prose to 65ch and let lists hold the full container so their columns align.
Do keep ember to a single recency mark per view and iris to interaction and focus.
Do stack two hairline plate edges below a list when a list needs to feel like a stack of sheets.
donts: Don't introduce a third typeface, a display size, or a second accent colour.
Don't round a corner, add a shadow, or use a gradient anywhere in the system.
Don't turn a list row into a card, a chip, or a nested surface.
Don't put colour on body copy or use ember as decoration; it means "new" or it does not appear.
Don't add a kicker, eyebrow, or decorative label above a heading; the heading speaks for itself.
